subject: Burnout web sites
author: Xandu
body:
Just after Burnout Paradise was released Criterion Games decided to redirect all the EA Burnout websites to CriterionGames.com. After this all the old Burnout sites including the 360 Revenge leaderboards disappeared. I contacted CG about this but never got a reply back so I guess they did not want the old sites around any more.

-- The Creator --
